# sherpa-empty-state

A centred placeholder for a blank list, grid, or region.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Empty State |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-empty-state/sherpa-empty-state.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-empty-state/sherpa-empty-state.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-empty-state/sherpa-empty-state.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-empty-state/sherpa-empty-state.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-empty-state/sherpa-empty-state.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-empty-state data-heading="No results" data-description="Try a different search."><sherpa-button>Clear filters</sherpa-button></sherpa-empty-state>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | message text (rendered into .message-text) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | heading text (rendered into .title) |
| `data-illustration` | `data` `empty` `error` `folder` `search` `success` | `empty` | built-in glyph: empty \| search \| folder \| data \| error \| success |
| `data-size` | `sm` `md` `lg` | `md` | sm \| md \| lg |
| `data-small-print` | text |  | fine-print / help text (rendered into .small-print-text) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `icon` | icon | custom illustration (reflects has-icon; replaces the glyph) |
| (default) | content | custom message body (reflects has-content-slot; replaces data-description) |
| `actions` | control | call-to-action controls (reflects has-actions) |
| `small-print` | text | custom fine-print body (reflects has-small-print; replaces data-small-print text) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `empty`, `heading`, `icon`, `message`, `message-text`, `small-print`, `small-print-text`, `title`
